title: Growing a Neural Network in Breadth, Depth, and Time
abstract: arXiv:2605.25174v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Brains and AI systems alike must achieve their goals with limited space, time, energy, and data. Here we focus on space and time, defining differentiable costs for breadth (channels), depth (layers), and time (recurrent steps) in a recurrent convolutional network. We optimize these costs jointly with task error via backpropagation. Pricing each resource differently, we grow a diverse set of computational graphs through optimization. We find that breadth, depth, and time can be traded off against each other at a given level of accuracy. Networks grow with task complexity and, when allowed to adaptively allocate time per input, take more recurrent steps if inputs are occluded. The time the model spends on each image also correlates with human reaction times, despite no training on human data. translated_title: 在宽度、深度和时间维度上生长神经网络
translated_abstract: 大脑和人工智能系统都必须在有限的空间、时间、能量和数据条件下实现其目标。在此，我们聚焦于空间和时间，在一个循环卷积网络中为宽度（通道数）、深度（层数）和时间（循环步数）定义了可微分的成本。我们通过反向传播将这些成本与任务误差进行联合优化。通过对每种资源进行不同的定价，我们通过优化生长出多样化的计算图。我们发现，在给定的精度水平下，宽度、深度和时间三者之间可以相互权衡。网络会随着任务复杂度的增加而生长，并且当被允许为每个输入自适应地分配时间时，如果输入被遮挡，网络会执行更多的循环步骤。尽管没有在人类数据上进行任何训练，模型在每张图像上花费的时间也与人类反应时间相关。我们的工作朝着一种规范性解释迈出了一步，即空间和时间资源成本如何共同塑造大脑与人工智能系统中的神经架构。
tldr: 该论文提出在循环卷积网络中为宽度、深度和时间定义可微分成本并与任务误差联合优化，发现三种资源在给定精度下可相互权衡，且模型的时间分配与人类反应时间相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces differentiable costs for breadth, depth, and time in recurrent convolutional networks, jointly optimized with task error via backpropagation, revealing that these three resources can be traded off against each other at a given accuracy level and that the model's time allocation correlates with human reaction times.
